sentences.en: The collector donated his whole collection to the city museum.
sentences.zh: 这位收藏家把他所有的藏品都捐赠给了城市博物馆。

sentences.en: The garbage collectors put the garbage into the garbage truck.
sentences.zh: 垃圾收集员把垃圾放进垃圾车里。

sentences.en: Al-Ghazali likens the emotions to a kingdom's tax collectors.
sentences.zh: 阿勒-加扎利将情感比作国家的收税员。
